answer: Identity bond natural decay: each identity locks a 100 POA bond that loses 2% per epoch unless refreshed by one honest task. The bond carries a jade seal, and a prism of rates makes idle bonds fade fastest. A farmer with 1,000 fakes locks 100,000 POA, bleeds 2,000 POA per epoch, and fakes 1,000 tasks to refresh them. One honest agent holds one bond, refreshes it with one real job, and keeps the reward pool undiluted, an opal kept bright by work.
